    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $logoPath) { $script:BrandLogo.Source = New-BrandBitmap $logoPath }
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $windowIconPath) { $window.Icon = New-BrandBitmap $windowIconPath }
} catch { }

function Invoke-UiRefresh {
    $frame = New-Object System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherFrame
    [System.Windows.Threading.Dispatcher]::CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke(
        [System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority]::Background,
        [System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherOperationCallback]{ param($f) $f.Continue = $false; return $null },
        $frame
    ) | Out-Null
    [System.Windows.Threading.Dispatcher]::PushFrame($frame)
}

function Write-Log([string]$Message, [string]$Level = 'INFO') {
    $line = "[{0}] [{1}] {2}" -f (Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm:ss'), $Level, $Message
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $script:LogFile -Value $line -Encoding UTF8
    $script:LogBox.AppendText($line + [Environment]::NewLine)
    $script:LogBox.ScrollToEnd()
    Invoke-UiRefresh
}

function Set-Progress([int]$Value, [string]$Message) {
    $script:Progress.Value = [Math]::Max(0, [Math]::Min(100, $Value))
    $script:StatusBadge.Text = $Message
    $script:FooterText.Text = $Message
    Invoke-UiRefresh
}

function Test-Internet([int]$TimeoutMs = 7000) {
    try {
        $request = [System.Net.WebRequest]::Create('https://www.microsoft.com/favicon.ico')
        $request.Timeout = $TimeoutMs
        $response = $request.GetResponse()
        $response.Close()
        return $true
    } catch { return $false }
}

function Get-AppArchitecture {
    $architecture = if ($env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432) { $env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432 } else { $env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE }
    switch -Regex ([string]$architecture) {
        'ARM64' { return 'arm64' }
        'AMD64|IA64' { return 'x64' }
        default { return 'x86' }
    }
}

function Invoke-SenetechUpdateCheck([switch]$SilentWhenCurrent) {
    if (-not (Test-Internet 3500)) {
        if (-not $SilentWhenCurrent) {
            [System.Windows.MessageBox]::Show(
                'Aucune connexion Internet disponible. Impossible de verifier les mises a jour SENETECH.',
                'SENETECH - Mise a jour',
                [System.Windows.MessageBoxButton]::OK,
                [System.Windows.MessageBoxImage]::Information) | Out-Null
        }
        return
    }

    try {
        Set-ControlsEnabled $false
        Set-Progress 15 'Verification de SENETECH'
        Write-Log ('Verification GitHub de SENETECH V{0}...' -f $script:DisplayVersion) 'UPDATE'

        try { [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12 } catch { }
        $headers = @{ 'User-Agent' = ('SENETECH-Setup/{0}' -f $script:AppVersion) }
        $manifest = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $script:UpdateManifestUrl -Headers $headers -UseBasicParsing

        $localVersion = New-Object System.Version($script:AppVersion)
        $remoteVersion = New-Object System.Version([string]$manifest.version)

        if ($remoteVersion -le $localVersion) {
            Set-Progress 100 'SENETECH est a jour'
            Write-Log ('SENETECH V{0} est deja a jour.' -f $script:DisplayVersion) 'OK'
            if (-not $SilentWhenCurrent) {
                [System.Windows.MessageBox]::Show(
                    ('SENETECH V{0} est deja a jour.' -f $script:DisplayVersion),
                    'SENETECH - Mise a jour',
                    [System.Windows.MessageBoxButton]::OK,
                    [System.Windows.MessageBoxImage]::Information) | Out-Null
            }
            return
        }

        if (-not $manifest.enabled) {
            Set-Progress 100 'Mise a jour indisponible'
            Write-Log ('Une version plus recente existe ({0}) mais sa diffusion est desactivee.' -f $manifest.displayVersion) 'ATTENTION'
            if (-not $SilentWhenCurrent) {
                [System.Windows.MessageBox]::Show(
                    ('Une nouvelle version ({0}) est referencee mais sa diffusion n est pas encore activee.' -f $manifest.displayVersion),
                    'SENETECH - Mise a jour',
                    [System.Windows.MessageBoxButton]::OK,
                    [System.Windows.MessageBoxImage]::Information) | Out-Null
            }
            return
        }

        $notes = @()
        if ($manifest.releaseNotes) { $notes = @($manifest.releaseNotes | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }) }
        $notesText = ''
        if ($notes.Count -gt 0) { $notesText = "`n`nNouveautes :`n- " + ($notes -join "`n- ") }
        $mandatoryText = if ([bool]$manifest.mandatory) { "`n`nCette mise a jour est marquee comme importante." } else { '' }

        $message = "Une nouvelle version de SENETECH est disponible.`n`nVersion installee : $($script:DisplayVersion)`nNouvelle version : $($manifest.displayVersion)$mandatoryText$notesText`n`nVoulez-vous l installer maintenant ?"
        $answer = [System.Windows.MessageBox]::Show(
            $message,
            'SENETECH - Mise a jour disponible',
            [System.Windows.MessageBoxButton]::YesNo,
            [System.Windows.MessageBoxImage]::Question)

        if ($answer -ne [System.Windows.MessageBoxResult]::Yes) {
            Set-Progress 0 'Mise a jour reportee'
            Write-Log 'Mise a jour SENETECH reportee par l utilisateur.' 'INFO'
            return
        }

        Set-Progress 35 'Preparation de la mise a jour'
        $updaterPath = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'SENETECH-UPDATE-SERVICE.ps1'
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $script:UpdaterUrl -Headers $headers -OutFile $updaterPath -UseBasicParsing

        $arguments = @(
            '-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass',
            '-File', ('"' + $updaterPath + '"'),
            '-CurrentVersion', ('"' + $script:AppVersion + '"'),
            '-InstallDir', ('"' + $script:Root + '"'),
            '-WaitForProcessId', [string]$PID
        )

        Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList ($arguments -join ' ') -WindowStyle Hidden | Out-Null
        Write-Log ('Mise a jour vers V{0} acceptee. Fermeture de SENETECH pour installation.' -f $manifest.displayVersion) 'UPDATE'
        Set-Progress 100 'Installation de la mise a jour'
        $script:NetworkTimer.Stop()
        $window.Close()
    } catch {
        Write-Log ('Echec de la verification des mises a jour : {0}' -f $_.Exception.Message) 'ERREUR'
        Set-Progress 0 'Erreur de mise a jour'
        [System.Windows.MessageBox]::Show(
            ("Impossible de verifier ou de preparer la mise a jour SENETECH.`n`n" + $_.Exception.Message),
            'SENETECH - Mise a jour',
            [System.Windows.MessageBoxButton]::OK,
            [System.Windows.MessageBoxImage]::Error) | Out-Null
    } finally {
        if ($window.IsVisible) { Set-ControlsEnabled $true }
    }
}

function Get-PreferredLocale {
    try {
        $locale = [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::CurrentUICulture.Name
        if ($locale) { return $locale }
    } catch { }
    return 'fr-FR'
}

function Get-WindowsSupport([int]$BuildNumber) {
    if ($BuildNumber -ge 22000) { return 'Windows 11 pris en charge' }
    if ($BuildNumber -ge 10240) { return 'Windows 10 pris en charge' }
    return 'Ancien Windows : diagnostic possible, installation non garantie'
}

function Get-ActivationState {
    try {
        $licensed = Get-CimInstance SoftwareLicensingProduct -Filter "ApplicationID='55c92734-d682-4d71-983e-d6ec3f16059f'" |
            Where-Object { $_.PartialProductKey -and $_.LicenseStatus -eq 1 } | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($licensed) { return 'Active' }
        return 'Non active ou non detectee'
    } catch { return 'Etat inconnu' }
}

function Get-StorageDetails {
    $items = @()
    try {
        foreach ($disk in @(Get-PhysicalDisk -ErrorAction Stop)) {
            $reliability = $null
            try { $reliability = Get-StorageReliabilityCounter -PhysicalDisk $disk -ErrorAction Stop }
            catch { }
            $items += [pscustomobject]@{
                Model = [string]$disk.FriendlyName
                Serial = [string]$disk.SerialNumber
                MediaType = [string]$disk.MediaType
                BusType = [string]$disk.BusType
                SizeGB = [Math]::Round([double]$disk.Size / 1GB, 0)
                Health = [string]$disk.HealthStatus
                Operational = ([string[]]$disk.OperationalStatus -join ', ')
                Temperature = if ($reliability) { $reliability.Temperature } else { $null }
                Wear = if ($reliability) { $reliability.Wear } else { $null }
                PowerOnHours = if ($reliability) { $reliability.PowerOnHours } else { $null }
                ReadErrors = if ($reliability) { $reliability.ReadErrorsTotal } else { $null }
                WriteErrors = if ($reliability) { $reliability.WriteErrorsTotal } else { $null }
            }
        }
    } catch {
        foreach ($disk in @(Get-CimInstance Win32_DiskDrive)) {
            $items += [pscustomobject]@{
